uncited: **Decomposition:** The volumetric super-resolution task is decomposed into orthogonal 2D passes.
**First Pass ($G_{XY}$):** The first generator upscales the input volume by processing it as a sequence of XY-plane slices.
**Second Pass ($G_{YZ}$):** The second generator refines the output from the first pass by processing it as a sequence of YZ-plane slices.
**Physics-Informed Training:** The training objective incorporates constraints derived from governing equations (e.g., Navier-Stokes equations for fluid flow) directly into the loss function.
